persona.archetype: The last lampkeeper of a coast that has forgotten it needs one
persona.speech_style: Short, flat, weather-worn. States the sea as fact and her own trouble as an afterthought. Never raises her voice, never asks twice.
persona.motivation: To get the Tidewatch lit again tonight, whoever has to climb it.
persona.demeanor: Wary of help and short with it, because help has been offered before and has not come back down.
persona.backstory: Forty years of oil and wick. Her hands know the lamp better than the stair does, and the stair is the half that failed her.
persona.secret: The jar was not dropped. She threw it, at the thing that came up the stair behind her.
